summary: Backend-only regression testing for deployment /health fix. Verified GET /health (no /api prefix) returns HTTP 200 with {status:'healthy'} on BOTH localhost:8001 (k8s probe origin) and external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Also ran regression sanity on /api/, /api/patterns, /api/pattern-room/analysis, /api/pattern-room/signals, /api/action-board, and POST /api/interpret (Turkish). All 8 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1000 lines; consider splitting into routers by domain (patterns, pattern-room, action-board, interpret) for maintainability.
/health route is intentionally root-level (correct for k8s probe). Good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment health-check fix verified. /health works on localhost:8001 AND external ingress. All /api routes intact. Interpret endpoint (Claude via emergentintegrations) returned valid JSON in ~15s.
rca of the issue: Previous 404 on /health caused by all routes being mounted under APIRouter(prefix='/api'). Fix: added @app.get('/health') at root FastAPI app level (after include_router). Confirmed 200 responses.
